comment: Retro Shelf manifest. Each game is the unchanged archive that its rights holder released; LICENSES.md has the review. 'file' is relative to vendor/retro/fetched/ and must match a 'file' pin in vendor/retro/retro.lock.json (same sha256 and bytes). tests.mjs checks both.

games.title: DOOM
games.sub: Shareware episode: Knee-Deep in the Dead
games.licence: id Software shareware: "SHAREWARE VERSION / PLEASE DISTRIBUTE!!!"
games.blurb: Nine levels on Phobos, a moon of Mars, as id Software sent them out to bulletin boards. The original DOS program runs in DOSBox.
games.controls: Arrows move, Ctrl fires, Space opens doors, Shift runs, Alt + arrows strafe, Esc is the menu, Tab the map. Gamepad: A fires, B opens, X runs, Y is Enter, the shoulder buttons strafe, Start is the menu, Back the map.

games.title: Beneath a Steel Sky
games.licence: Revolution Software freeware licence: free distribution with the readme intact
games.blurb: A cyberpunk point-and-click thriller with art by Dave Gibbons. Robert Foster and the robot Joey must learn the truth about his past and about Union City.
games.controls: Point and click with the mouse or touch. Ctrl+F5 opens the ScummVM menu (save, load, quit).

games.title: Flight of the Amazon Queen
games.licence: Freeware licence of the authors: free distribution with the readme intact
games.blurb: Pilot Joe King crashes in the Amazon jungle in the 1940s and finds Amazon women, six-foot pygmies and a very suspicious lederhosen company.
games.controls: Point and click with the mouse or touch. Ctrl+F5 opens the ScummVM menu (save, load, quit).

games.title: Lure of the Temptress
games.licence: Revolution Software freeware licence: free distribution with the licence intact
games.blurb: Revolution's first game. Diermot wakes in a dungeon in Turnvale, a town that the sorceress Selena holds with her Skorl.
games.controls: Point and click with the mouse or touch. Ctrl+F5 opens the ScummVM menu (save, load, quit).

games.title: Drascula: The Vampire Strikes Back
games.licence: Alcachofa Soft freeware licence: free distribution with the readme intact
games.blurb: A comedy adventure from Spain: estate agent John Hacker goes to Transylvania to save B.J. from Count Drascula.
games.controls: Point and click with the mouse or touch. Ctrl+F5 opens the ScummVM menu (save, load, quit).

games.title: Sołtys
games.licence: LK Avalon freeware licence: free distribution with the licence intact
games.blurb: A comic point-and-click adventure from Poland. A sołtys is the elected head of a Polish village.
games.controls: Point and click with the mouse or touch. Ctrl+F5 opens the ScummVM menu (save, load, quit).

games.title: Sfinx
games.licence: LK Avalon freeware licence: free distribution with the licence intact
games.blurb: A fairy-tale point-and-click adventure from LK Avalon, the studio of Sołtys.
games.controls: Point and click with the mouse or touch. Ctrl+F5 opens the ScummVM menu (save, load, quit).

systems.name: PlayStation
systems.biosNote: Not needed: the core has its own BIOS (HLE). If you own a PlayStation BIOS dump, you can add it for better compatibility.

systems.name: NES / Famicom
systems.biosNote: Only Famicom Disk System games need a BIOS (disksys.rom). You must supply it from your own console.

systems.name: Game Boy Advance
systems.biosNote: Not needed: mGBA has its own BIOS (HLE). A gba_bios.bin dump from your own console is optional.
